policies.title: Chad: current eVisa for six established non-exempt ordinary passports
policies.summary: Current passport-authority sources establish a visa requirement for Danish, Australian, Mexican, Seychellois, Russian and Kuwaiti ordinary visitors. Chad's May and June 2026 official notices supersede their prior mission route for every new non-diplomatic or courtesy visa with pre-travel electronic issuance.
conditions: Applies only to ordinary Danish, Australian, Mexican, Seychellois, Russian and Kuwaiti passports for a short visitor trip. The cited passport-authority sources establish that a visa is required for each listed passport; no exemption is inferred from the portal list.
From 11 May 2026 every new visa application must be submitted exclusively through evisa.td. Diplomatic and courtesy visas remain with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and are excluded.

The official portal says the entry visa is now issued online, and its FAQ/circular direct application before entry: it recommends at least seven days before entry, with standard processing stated as ten working days and express processing as 72 hours.

Visas regularly issued before the 21 May 2026 cut-over remain valid until expiry; visas issued outside evisa.td after that cut-over do not permit entry. No accessible cited source establishes a special sanction, suspension, residence, third-country-document, work, transit or special-passport route for this six-passport cohort.
Approval, supporting documents, health, security and final immigration admission remain individual requirements.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: Standard: 10 working days; express: 72 hours. Apply at least 7 days before entry.
steps: Submit the new visa application online through evisa.td before entry.
Upload the passport and required electronic supporting documents and pay as directed.
Travel after electronic issuance; final admission remains with Chadian immigration.
